title: Competitor outage webhook feed + procurement auto-trigger prototype
creator: Marta Silva
description: Build a lightweight prototype that ingests public signals about competitor model outages (status pages, API error rates, marketplace notices) and emits a webhook feed into Redwood procurement and SRE processes. The feed should power automated procurement alerts (suggest reserve capacity, surface fallback-ready models) and a human-review path for account teams. Goal: reduce detection-to-mitigation time for model availability shocks and provide early procurement triggers for Dedicated/Private customers.
acceptance_criteria: A prototype webhook endpoint publishes structured outage events (model, region, severity, evidence links)
Procurement rule mappings exist: outage -> recommended reserve action (e.g., dedicate 1k$ burst, enable canary model X)
Integration demo with SRE channel (Slack alert) and procurement dashboard row
Runbook drafted for ops + AE handoff with checklist and decision thresholds
comments: 2026-02-16 - Marta Silva: Kickoff w/ SRE and Procurement. Agreed to start with three signal sources: official status pages, synthetic API probes (latency/5xx spike detection), and marketplace availability crawls.

2026-02-22 - Benji Clark: PoC architecture doc uploaded to Drive: https://drive.redwood/example/procurement-webhook-poc (PRD + sequence diagram). Using Cloud Functions to normalize feeds into a single event schema.
2026-03-02 - Priya Nair (SRE review): Prefer event schema include time-series sample (30m window) and confidence score. Also requested debounce logic to reduce noise.
2026-03-08 - Legal (R. Huang): flagged potential signal reliability language for customer communications. Added follow-up task to draft templated customer notice.
2026-03-12 - Benji Clark: Implemented initial webhook; demo scheduled with procurement and AE leads on 2026-03-18. GitHub PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/procurement-sentinels/pull/67
notes: Prototype should be intentionally scoped: 8-week spike to validate signal quality and operational handoffs. If signals hit >80% precision for outage v. transient blips, move to production engineering with dedicated SLA rules. Coordinate with Legal for customer communication templates and with Console UX for procurement dashboard integration. Consider eventual extension to auto-provisioning triggers for Reserved/Dedicated capacity only after safety checks.
